data.name: Titanic Challenge
data.description: A saurian champion considers only the largest creatures a true challenge. His titanic challenge adds only +%1 on damage rolls against Medium or smaller creatures, but he adds a +1 bonus on attack rolls against a target of his challenge that is at least two size categories larger than himself (Huge for Medium saurian champions) and a +2 bonus on attack rolls against a Colossal target of his challenge. This alters challenge.|CavalierChallengeLVL/2
